verdict.rationale: Expensify has its own card program: the Expensify Card is referenced in the pricing update, and the company-credit-card page promises spend control. The spend-management page lists "Smart Limits on cards," which points to per-card spend limits. The evidence never describes issuing physical versus virtual cards or how fast issuance is. Missing for 10: explicit physical and virtual card issuance, evidence that cards can be issued in minutes, detail on configuring individual per-card limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
